title: Project Manager and Foremans
description: Project Manager coordinates Foreman-A through Foreman-E in one council room. Each Foreman owns one 20-worker pool, so 100 workers are shown as five aggregate pools instead of 100 separate chats.

messages.text: I split the build into five Foreman packets: A, B, C, D, and E. Each Foreman gets a 20-worker pool, and worker chatter stays aggregated unless an exception affects the global run.

messages.systemLog: Tools Call: channel.open: Project Manager opens the Foreman council and publishes the five work packets.

messages.text: Packet A accepted. My pool owns workers 001-020 and will report only pool totals plus blocking exceptions.
Packet B accepted. My pool owns workers 021-040 and will avoid all writes on the shared locked seam.
Packet C accepted. My pool owns workers 041-060 and will pause dependent rows until the required gates are green.
Packet D accepted. My pool owns workers 061-080 and will route uncertain cells to review instead of guessing.
Packet E accepted. My pool owns workers 081-100 and will track temporary tags, cleanup, and diff collection.
Foreman worker pools may start. Keep the right-side chat focused on pool summaries, checkpoint events, and only the worker exceptions that affect the global run.

messages.systemLog: Tools Call: channel.open: Project Manager starts the five Foreman worker-pool rooms.

messages.text: Worker-pool build phase complete. Foreman-A through Foreman-E flushed diffs, patches, checkpoints, temporary tags, and skill-cache updates for verification.

messages.systemLog: Tools Call: channel.close: Project Manager collects Foreman outputs and moves the build to final verification.
